headlines.title: FedEx (FDX) Stock May Be 44% Undervalued Despite Fuel Surcharge Changes
headlines.summary: FedEx Corporation has delivered a strong share price run in recent years, which puts a spotlight on whether the current US$300.58 price is well supported by the cash it can generate. With the stock sharply higher over the past year, the central issue for you as an investor is how that move lines up with the underlying cash flow story. FedEx has returned 75.

headlines.title: FedEx (FDX) Names A New CFO, Is The Stock Still 15% Undervalued?
headlines.summary: FedEx (FDX) turned investors’ attention to its leadership bench on October 26, 2026, after naming experienced finance executive Jamere Jackson as Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President, effective November 30. The leadership move lands as FedEx shares trade at US$300.58, with a 30 day share price return of 5.15% and a 7 day gain of 2.31% that partly offsets a 90 day share price decline of 3.86%. Across a longer window, the picture looks stronger.

headlines.title: FedEx hires AutoZone’s Jamere Jackson as CFO
headlines.summary: The new finance chief's pay package includes a $2 million signing bonus, paid in two installments a year apart.

headlines.title: FedEx nabs AutoZone alum as new CFO
headlines.summary: AutoZone’s Jamere Jackson will step in as CFO for FedEx as the company continues with a seven-month “transition period” following the FedEx Freight spinoff.

headlines.title: USPS to debut weekly fuel fee in 2027, matching FedEx, UPS practices
headlines.summary: The surcharge for package shipping services will be tied to diesel and jet fuel prices, which have been climbing this year.

description: FedEx Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides transportation, e-commerce, and business services in the United States and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Express U.S. Domestic and Express International. It provides e-commerce and digital solutions; dataworks; printing and shipping management, including digital printing, professional finishing, document creation, design solutions, direct mail, signs and graphics, custom-branded boxes, copying, computer rental, Wi-Fi, corporate print solutions, shredding, U.S. passport processing and renewal, and digital notarization; packing services, as well as packing supplies and boxes; document and business services; and retail access for package transportation. In addition, the company offers logistics services, air and ocean cargo transportation, specialty transportation, customs brokerage, trade management tools and data, and door-to-door solutions; and third party logistics and supply chain management solutions, such as inbound logistics, warehousing and distribution, fulfillment, contract packaging and product configuration, systems integration, returns process and disposition, test, repair, refurbishment, and product liquidation. Further, it provides sales, marketing, administrative, information technology, and back-office support services. FedEx Corporation was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Memphis, Tennessee.
